correctness.rationale: Each path of the endpoint permutation channel sends the two initial coin basis states to distinct orthogonal basis states; origin projections are diagonal, and reflection plus coin exchange gives equal survival from either basis state. The row sum of the published inverse Green matrix is [(1−z)v+(1+z)u]/2. Dividing by 1−z gives (1+z) times the even part of H_p(z), with H_p(z)=sqrt[(1−(1−2p)z)/(1−z)], so the submitted even coefficients and parity follow. At p=0 H_0=1 and detection is exactly at 2. At 0<p<1 the even generating function in w=z² has its leading term sqrt(p)(1−w)^(−1/2) and only higher Puiseux terms plus an analytic part; the other branch point lies outside the unit circle. At p=1 that even function is exactly (1−w)^(−1/2). Transferring coefficients of it and of 1−(1−w) times it gives both constants, with survival tending to zero but not summable. Independently, for N≥1 the coefficient of z^N in H_p is p times the integral of (1−p+p cos θ)^(N−1)(1+cos θ)dθ/π on [0,π]. Summing the geometric series and integrating 1/(A−B cos θ) with A=1−(1−p)z, B=pz gives H_p−1 and verifies this exact representation. For Np bounded the log of the power differs from −Np(1−cos θ) by O(p) uniformly, including bounded N; integration gives exp(−Np)(I₀+I₁). Divide by S₂=p−p²/2 and use parity with n=floor(t/(2p)) at positive fixed t. At t=0 the conditional tail is one. The Bessel derivative and large-argument asymptotics give the stated density and far tail. Independent rational monitoring on even times through 24 at p=0, 1/40, 1/3, 3/4, 1 matched the integral via the moments ∫cos^(2j)θ dθ/π=binom(2j,j)/4^j and zero odd moments. The supplied script was read, not executed. No fixed-p error uniform down to zero, generic coin, or unmonitored claim is inferred.

evidence: The candidate law has Laplace transform 1−s[sqrt(1+2/s)−1]=1+s−sqrt(s(s+2)). First-event analysis of the M/M/1 with arrival and service rates both 1/2 gives B=(1+B²)/(2(1+s)), with that transform as the bounded solution. Thus the limiting density is exactly that of the critical busy period from one customer; the inspected queue paper explicitly notes an exact Bessel law.

value.rationale: The novel component is not a new special-function law: it explains which rare trajectories carry the long tail of this monitored model. It quantifies both their vanishing weight and their nonexponential order-p⁻¹ delay, including uniformity for bounded scaled times where the fixed-noise asymptotic is inadequate. That gives an explicit interpretation of the singular p=0 limit beyond recurrence or a finite-time table.
